unauthorized.message: Your API key is missing, invalid, disabled or expired.
unauthorized.action: Use an active API key from your dashboard.

access_denied.message: Your account does not have access to this request.
access_denied.action: Check account status, policy acceptance and domain access in your dashboard.

account_disabled.action: Contact support to review your account.

account_expired.action: Check your access in the dashboard or contact support.

policies_required.message: Accept the current Terms and Privacy Policy before using the API.
policies_required.action: Open your dashboard and accept the current policies.

domain_not_approved.message: Access to {domain} has not been approved.
domain_not_approved.action: Request access to this domain in your dashboard.

domain_pending.action: Check the domain request in your dashboard. Retry once it is approved.

insufficient_credits.message: No available allowance or sufficient wallet balance remains.
insufficient_credits.action: Top up your wallet or add an active allowance in your dashboard.

credits_warming.action: Wait a moment, then retry. Contact support if this continues.

rate_limited.message: Your account request rate is too high.
rate_limited.action: Wait for Retry-After, then send requests more slowly.

rate_limit_exceeded.message: Your account request rate is too high.
rate_limit_exceeded.action: Wait for Retry-After, then send requests more slowly.

concurrency_exceeded.message: Too many requests are running at once.
concurrency_exceeded.action: Wait for running requests to finish, then retry.

capacity_exceeded.action: Wait for Retry-After, then retry with fewer concurrent requests.

invalid_input.message: Some request fields are missing or invalid.
invalid_input.action: Check the request fields against the API reference.

unsupported_profile.message: The browser profile is invalid or unsupported.
unsupported_profile.action: Check the profile fields against the API reference.

unsupported_material.message: The supplied scripts did not produce usable headers or form fields.
unsupported_material.action: Upload complete, current scripts in execution order. Contact support with the request ID if this continues.

input_too_large.message: The request exceeds the upload limit.
input_too_large.action: Reduce the request size to the documented limits.

output_too_large.message: The generated response exceeds the output limit.
output_too_large.action: Contact support with the request ID.

unsupported_encoding.message: The request encoding is not supported.
unsupported_encoding.action: Use a supported Content-Encoding from the API reference.

unsupported_media_type.message: The request content type is not supported.
unsupported_media_type.action: Send the API request as application/json.

input_timeout.message: The request upload took too long.
input_timeout.action: Finish the upload within the documented deadline, then retry.

material_expired.action: Upload the scripts again to obtain a fresh reference.

material_context_mismatch.message: The material reference belongs to a different page URL.
material_context_mismatch.action: Use the original source_url or upload scripts for the new page.

material_cache_full.message: The material cache is at capacity.
material_cache_full.action: Wait before uploading more material, or reuse a valid reference.

material_cache_unavailable.action: Contact support with the request ID if this continues.

generation_timeout.action: Retry once with backoff. Contact support with the request ID if this continues.

generation_unavailable.action: Retry with backoff. Contact support with the request ID if this continues.

authentication_unavailable.message: API key verification is temporarily unavailable.
authentication_unavailable.action: Wait before retrying. Contact support if this continues.

generation_failed.action: Check that all required scripts are included in execution order, including scripts loaded by a loader. If all required scripts were supplied, contact support with the request ID so we can investigate runtime compatibility.

generation_incomplete.action: Check that all required scripts are included in execution order, including scripts loaded by a loader. If all required scripts were supplied, contact support with the request ID so we can investigate runtime compatibility.

generation_invalid_headers.message: Generated headers did not pass validation.
generation_invalid_headers.action: Contact support with the request ID so we can investigate runtime compatibility and the supplied material.

generation_invalid_form.message: Generated form did not pass validation.
generation_invalid_form.action: Contact support with the request ID so we can investigate runtime compatibility and the supplied material.

unknown_material.message: The supplied material could not produce a valid result.
unknown_material.action: Check the supplied material. Contact support with the request ID if this continues.
